top_signals.title: Ed Yardeni Lowers Year-End S&P 500 Target to 7,900
top_signals.summary: Edward Yardeni, president at Yardeni Research, points to geopolitical developments and higher-for-longer oil prices, among other factors, that led him to lower his year-end target for the S&P 500. He says his previous target of 8,400 is more likely to be reached by the middle of next year. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Europe's Biggest Independent Solar Operator Just Went Bankrupt
top_signals.summary: The soaring wind and solar capacity installations in Germany have created an unsustainable business and project economics environment in the sector amid slower grid expansion and electricity generation curtailments. In 2023, Germany crossed the 50% mark of the share of renewable energy in its electricity generation. This year, renewable energy accounted for a record-high 58% of Germany’s electricity consumption in the first half, up from 55.8% for the same period last year, estimates by industry associations ZSW and BDEW showed in July. top_signals.title: Beauty Tech shares glow as boss brushes off ‘cheap’ rivals
top_signals.summary: Beauty Tech Group boss Laurence Newman has brushed off competition from ‘cheap beauty devices’ after the London-listed firm more than tripled its first-half profit.
